qe: [BSSC LDC 2025 PYQ] Read the passage and answer: 'On October 2nd, a group of school students initiated a plastic cleanup drive in their locality. They collected over 500 kg of waste and submitted it for recycling. Inspired by Gandhian principles of self-discipline and cleanliness, the students voluntarily planned and executed the event without external pressure. Their dedication encouraged several adults to join the effort. Local authorities commended their work and provided logistical support. The success of the campaign received attention from multiple news channels, and soon, schools in nearby towns replicated the initiative. Several households also pledged to reduce single-use plastic, and some local businesses started offering eco-friendly alternatives.' — Question: What was the primary motivation behind the students' cleanup drive?
qh: [BSSC LDC 2025 PYQ] गद्यांश के अनुसार छात्रों के सफाई अभियान के पीछे मुख्य प्रेरणा क्या थी?
e: The passage states they were 'Inspired by Gandhian principles of self-discipline and cleanliness'.

qh: [BSSC LDC 2025 PYQ] 'आसपास के कस्बों के स्कूलों को इस पहल को दोहराने के लिए प्रेरित करना' किस संबंध को दर्शाता है?
e: The students' successful cleanup (cause) prompted nearby schools to replicate it (effect).

qh: [BSSC LDC 2025 PYQ] इस सफाई अभियान का निम्नलिखित में से क्या परिणाम हुआ?
oe: Conferment of a national civilian award by constitutional authorities.
Introduction of statutory regulation on plastic use in the locality.
Amplification of the initiative through media coverage, prompting emulation in neighbouring regions.
Institutional suspension of academic activity post event.
oh: संवैधानिक प्राधिकारियों द्वारा राष्ट्रीय नागरिक सम्मान दिया गया।
स्थानीय स्तर पर प्लास्टिक पर वैधानिक कानून बना।
मीडिया कवरेज से पहल का प्रसार हुआ, जिससे पड़ोसी क्षेत्रों में भी इसका अनुकरण हुआ।
कार्यक्रम के बाद शैक्षणिक गतिविधियाँ निलंबित हुईं।
e: News channels covered the campaign and schools in nearby towns replicated the initiative.

qe: [BSSC LDC 2025 PYQ] Cloze Passage: 'The Himalayas are not only a physical barrier but also a climatic (29) _____. They prevent the cold winds from Central Asia from entering India, thus helping to maintain a (30) _____ winter climate in the north. Moreover, they play a crucial role in causing rainfall by (31) _____ the monsoon winds. These mountains are also home to a (32) _____ range of flora and fauna and are considered a (33) _____ zone of biodiversity.' — Fill blank (29): 'also a climatic (29) _____.'
qh: [BSSC LDC 2025 PYQ] रिक्त स्थान (29) भरें: 'also a climatic (29) _____.'
e: The Himalayas protect India like a climatic 'shield' against freezing Central Asian winds.

qe: [BSSC LDC 2025 PYQ] Cloze Passage: 'The Himalayas are not only a physical barrier but also a climatic (29) _____. e: Blocking icy Central Asian winds keeps North Indian winters 'moderate' rather than freezing.

qe: [BSSC LDC 2025 PYQ] Pick the correct meaning of the idiom: 'To turn a blind eye'.
qh: [BSSC LDC 2025 PYQ] 'To turn a blind eye' मुहावरे का सही अर्थ चुनें:
e: 'Turn a blind eye' means pretending not to notice something wrong intentionally.

qe: [BSSC LDC 2025 PYQ] Which of the following is a valid English verb-noun collocation with 'promise' (as keyed in BSSC 02/25)?
qh: [BSSC LDC 2025 PYQ] 'promise' के साथ उपयुक्त अंग्रेजी कोलोकेशन चुनें:
e: In BSSC 02/25 official key, 'Give a promise' (alongside 'make a promise') is the accepted collocation (whereas 'take/do/catch a promise' are non-idiomatic).

qe: [BSSC LDC 2025 PYQ] Correct the incorrect question tag in: 'He never came to school, didn't he?'
qh: [BSSC LDC 2025 PYQ] वाक्य में गलत Question Tag को सुधारें: 'He never came to school, didn't he?'
e: Because 'never' makes the main clause negative, the question tag must be positive in Simple Past: 'did he?'.

qe: [BSSC LDC 2025 PYQ] One-word substitution: 'One who loves mankind is called:'
qh: [BSSC LDC 2025 PYQ] वाक्यांश के लिए एक शब्द: 'One who loves mankind':
e: Philanthropist = lover of mankind; Misanthrope = hater of mankind; Misogynist = hater of women.

qe: [BSSC LDC 2025 PYQ] Choose the ANTONYM of 'Rigid' (implied contrast in standard LDC vocab: 'Flexible'): What is the opposite of 'RIGID'?
qh: [BSSC LDC 2025 PYQ] 'RIGID' (कठोर/अनम्य) का विलोम (Antonym) चुनें:
e: Rigid (inflexible) is opposite to Flexible.

qe: [BSSC LDC 2025 PYQ] Change to Passive Voice: 'They are watching a movie.'
qh: [BSSC LDC 2025 PYQ] Passive Voice में बदलें: 'They are watching a movie.'
oe: A movie is being watched by them.
A movie was watched by them.
A movie has been watched by them.
A movie is watched by them.
oh: A movie is being watched by them.
A movie was watched by them.
A movie has been watched by them.
A movie is watched by them.
e: Present Continuous Active ('are watching') → Passive ('is being watched').

qe: [BSSC LDC 2025 PYQ] Choose the correct modal: 'You ____ finish your homework before going out.'
qh: [BSSC LDC 2025 PYQ] सही Modal चुनें: 'You ____ finish your homework before going out.'
e: 'Must' expresses strong obligation or necessity.

qe: [BSSC LDC 2025 PYQ] Complete the third-conditional sentence: 'If he ____ the train, he would have been on time.'
qh: [BSSC LDC 2025 PYQ] वाक्य पूरा करें: 'If he ____ the train, he would have been on time.'
e: Third conditional: If + Past Perfect ('had caught'), ... would have + V₃.

qe: [BSSC LDC 2025 PYQ] Choose the correctly spelled word for 'continuing firmly despite difficulty':
qh: [BSSC LDC 2025 PYQ] 'दृढ़ता/निरंतर प्रयास' अर्थ वाले शब्द की सही वर्तनी चुनें:
e: Correct spelling ends with '-ence': P-E-R-S-I-S-T-E-N-C-E.

qe: [BSSC LDC 2025 PYQ] Arrange the words to form a meaningful sentence: 1. vegetables  2. fresh  3. from the market  4. buys  5. mother
qh: [BSSC LDC 2025 PYQ] सार्थक वाक्य बनाने हेतु सही क्रम चुनें: 1. vegetables  2. fresh  3. from the market  4. buys  5. mother
e: 5-4-2-1-3 forms: 'Mother buys fresh vegetables from the market.'

qe: [BSSC LDC 2025 PYQ] Fill in the blank with the correct preposition: 'She is confident _____ her success.'
qh: [BSSC LDC 2025 PYQ] सही Preposition भरें: 'She is confident _____ her success.'
e: Adjective 'confident' takes 'of' ('confident of success').

qe: [BSSC LDC 2025 PYQ] Choose the ANTONYM of 'Scarcity':
qh: [BSSC LDC 2025 PYQ] 'Scarcity' (कमी/अभाव) का विलोम (Antonym) चुनें:
e: Scarcity = shortage; Plenty = abundance.

qe: [BSSC LDC 2025 PYQ] Convert to Indirect Speech: She said, "I am studying for my exams."
qh: [BSSC LDC 2025 PYQ] Indirect Speech में बदलें: She said, "I am studying for my exams."
oe: She said she was studying for her exams.
She said she is studying for her exams.
She said she studies for her exams.
She said she had studied for her exams.
oh: She said she was studying for her exams.
She said she is studying for her exams.
She said she studies for her exams.
She said she had studied for her exams.
e: Present Continuous ('am studying') backshifts to Past Continuous ('was studying') with past reporting verb 'said'.

qe: [BSSC LDC 2025 PYQ] Fill in the blank: 'Despite the warnings, she ____ to ignore the signs.'
qh: [BSSC LDC 2025 PYQ] रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'Despite the warnings, she ____ to ignore the signs.'
e: Finite past verb 'chose' (past tense of choose) completes the main clause.

qe: [BSSC LDC 2025 PYQ] Choose the SYNONYM of 'Reluctant':
qh: [BSSC LDC 2025 PYQ] 'Reluctant' (अनिच्छुक) का समानार्थी (Synonym) चुनें:
e: Reluctant = unwilling/hesitant; Eager/Willing = keen.

qe: [BSSC LDC 2025 PYQ] Select the sentence in the Simple Past tense:
qh: [BSSC LDC 2025 PYQ] Simple Past Tense वाला वाक्य चुनें:
e: Subject + V₂ ('visited') is Simple Past tense.

qe: [BSSC LDC 2025 PYQ] Correct the grammatically faulty sentence: 'The book is too interesting to put it down.'
qh: [BSSC LDC 2025 PYQ] व्याकरण की दृष्टि से त्रुटिपूर्ण वाक्य को सुधारें: 'The book is too interesting to put it down.'
oe: The book is too interesting to be put down.
The book is very interesting to be put down.
The book is so interesting to put down.
oh: The book is too interesting to be put down.
The book is very interesting to be put down.
The book is so interesting to put down.
e: When the subject ('The book') is the logical object of the infinitive, use passive infinitive 'to be put down' without redundant 'it'.

qe: Identify the part with an error: 'Neither Ramesh (A) / nor his friends (B) / was present at the office. (C) / No error (D)'
qh: त्रुटि वाला भाग पहचानें: 'Neither Ramesh (A) / nor his friends (B) / was present at the office. (C) / No error (D)'
e: With 'Neither...nor', the verb agrees with the nearer subject 'his friends' (plural) → 'were'.

qe: Fill in the blank: 'He has been working as a clerk here ______ 2020.'
qh: रिक्त स्थान भरें: 'He has been working as a clerk here ______ 2020.'
e: 'Since' is used with a specific starting point in time (2020); 'for' is used with duration (five years).

qe: Choose the SYNONYM of 'CONCISE':
qh: 'CONCISE' (संक्षिप्त एवं स्पष्ट) का समानार्थी चुनें:
e: Concise means expressing much in few clear words.

qe: What does the idiom 'Hit the nail on the head' mean?
qh: 'Hit the nail on the head' मुहावरे का अर्थ क्या है?
oe: To hurt one's finger with a hammer
To describe or identify the exact truth or core point accurately
oh: बिल्कुल सही बात कहना या मुख्य बिंदु को सटीकता से पकड़ना
e: 'Hit the nail on the head' means being exactly right about something.

qe: One-word substitution for: 'A speech delivered without prior preparation'
qh: वाक्यांश के लिए एक शब्द: 'A speech delivered without prior preparation'
e: Extempore (or Impromptu) = spoken without preparation.
